$comment: The pin of this repository's one build. Everything the build takes from outside is named here: change a value in a pull request, never in a script.
The weekly upstream check (.github/workflows/upstream.yml) opens a pull request that moves btbn.commit and ffmpeg.commit/describe; merging it to main builds and publishes a release.

The toolchain images are built from scratch by BtbN's own makeimage.sh at btbn.commit, FROM the Ubuntu index digest below. Their apt, rustup and crosstool-ng inputs are not pinned (BtbN's do not pin them either): a release is the same scripts and the same sources, not the same bytes. The sha256 of each release's zip is what a consumer pins.

BtbN's ghcr.io images (ghcr.io/btbn/ffmpeg-builds/base, base-win64) are not used: they are rebuilt daily under a moving :latest tag, and BtbN's cleanup deletes the untagged older digests, so a digest of theirs stops resolving within days.

remove_scripts.scripts.d/50-chromaprint.sh: Chromaprint, an audio-fingerprint muxer we do not use. It links FFTW, which is GPL-2.0-or-later, statically into avformat (found in the shipped BtbN avformat-63.dll: fftw-3.3.11, 1017 strings).
remove_scripts.scripts.d/25-fftw3.sh: FFTW itself. In the lgpl variants only Chromaprint depends on it; the other dependent, 50-rubberband.sh, is disabled for every lgpl variant (its ffbuild_enabled returns -1), so nothing in win64 lgpl-shared needs it.
remove_scripts.scripts.d/50-zvbi.sh: libzvbi, DVB teletext, which we accept losing. Its COPYING.md puts packet-830 and pdc under GPL-2.0 only.

dependency_check: At btbn.commit, grep of scripts.d, variants, addins and util for chromaprint|fftw|zvbi finds: 50-chromaprint.sh (itself, and 'echo fftw3'), 50-rubberband.sh ('echo fftw3', disabled for lgpl), 50-zvbi.sh (itself), zz-final.sh ('echo chromaprint', 'echo zvbi' in its ffbuild_depends list). Nothing else. zz-final.sh is the build's entry script: a dependency on a removed script is silently dropped by generate.sh ('|| continue'), so the two lines are deleted explicitly (scripts/apply-patches.sh) and the finished configure line is checked (scripts/verify.py).

edit_files.scripts.d/zz-final.sh: delete the lines 'echo chromaprint' and 'echo zvbi' from ffbuild_depends
edit_files.build.sh: after 'cd ffmpeg', 'git checkout --detach <ffmpeg.commit>': BtbN builds the branch head; this builds the commit above
